description: Build an unsigned transaction to liquidate an unhealthy position: repay part of someone else's debt and receive their collateral plus the liquidation bonus. Only viable while that position's health factor is below 1 (check get_user_summary for the target). v4 takes collateral and debt as reserveIds; v3 takes collateralToken and debtToken addresses plus chainId. Non-custodial: the liquidator signs and submits.

amount.description: Debt to cover, in main units. Omit only if max=true.

collateral.description: v4 only: reserveId of the collateral to seize.

debt.description: v4 only: reserveId of the debt to repay.

liquidator.description: v4 only: the wallet performing the liquidation (0x, 40 hex). On v3 the liquidator is whoever signs the returned transaction.

market.description: v3 only: market pool address (from get_markets).

max.description: Cover the maximum the protocol allows.

version.description: Protocol version (v3 or v4; required, no 'all' for actions).

name: prepare_liquidation
title: Prepare a liquidation
